{{Top|leg}}
'''Orbiting telescopes''' were [[Telescope/Legends|telescopes]] that were launched or built in [[Realspace/Legends|space]] near a [[Planet/Legends|planet]], and then followed an [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] around it. Beings could use the telescope via controls located on the planet.

==Uses==
Orbiting telescopes were used through out [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] to monitor far away events and locations, such as the ones used by [[ExGal-4]] while monitoring the [[Galactic Horizon]]. These telescopes where the first devices to see [[Yuuzhan Vong]] technology, however at the time it was believed to be simply an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]].
